title: Antigua: A City Built for Earthquakes
goal: Explain how colonial Antigua was built and what happened in 1773, with a pesar de and pese a.
grammar: concession with a pesar de que and pese a

sections.title: Antigua: A City Built for Earthquakes
body: In this lesson you walk through Antigua Guatemala, a colonial capital between volcanoes. You will read why its churches were built the way they were, and what the earthquakes of 1773 changed.
The grammar is the one you know for saying that something happened in spite of a difficulty: *a pesar de que* and *pese a*.

items: I can say that something happened in spite of a difficulty, with *a pesar de que* and *pese a*.
I can describe why the churches of Antigua have thick walls and low towers.
I can tell what happened to the capital in 1773.
